pipeline_identity.import_precedence: C3:14-15 and C2:149-153 bind repository code
pipeline_identity.protocol_name_caveat: M3 calls this standard inpainting; C5 contains a repository-specific __call__. Conclusions are from this implementation, not from its class name.

chain.input: hash-bound normal RGB full canvas and frozen weak bbox
chain.output: 512x512 RGB crop at floor(bbox_center-256), black-padded outside source; no reposition
chain.constraint: fixed crop origin and translation are hard; generated content is not

chain.output: 512x512 L rectangle, floor(left/top), ceil(right/bottom), exclusive upper bounds, 0/255
chain.constraint: raster support is hard; mask is NOT human defect segmentation

chain.input: same-size RGB crop and L mask
chain.output: RGB [1,3,512,512] normalized to [-1,1]; binary mask [1,1,512,512]; latent-size nearest interpolation
chain.resize: processor calls same-size Lanczos resize at explicit 512x512; no geometry scale change
chain.constraint: coordinate grid is retained; intensity generation is not hard

chain.input: normal crop, binary mask, fresh CPU generator
chain.output: full spatial noise latent; masked-normal posterior sample; original-normal posterior sampled first
chain.constraint: strength=1 initializes ALL latent cells with noise. Two VAE posterior sampling calls also consume slot RNG, so RNG variation is not only initial diffusion noise.
chain.shape: VAE latent shape [1,C_lat,H_lat,W_lat]; SD2 4-channel latent concatenated with 1 mask and 4 conditioning channels gives 9-channel UNet input

chain.input: CFG duplicated full latent, mask, masked-normal latent, prompt
chain.output: scheduler-updated full spatial latent at every step
chain.constraint: mask is conditioning input, not a hard restoration operator. DDIM step has no normal/background or mask parameter; no unmasked-latent restoration anywhere in active loop.
chain.inactive_paths: prepare_latents/prepare_mask_latents helpers above __call__ and C6.apply_overlay are not called by this path

chain.output: decoded whole patch, normalized/clamped [0,1] RGB numpy, rounded/clipped to uint8 RGB
chain.constraint: safety checker disabled; no bbox composite or copied background at this step

chain.input: uint8 generated patch and original normal RGB canvas
chain.output: PNG full canvas with ENTIRE valid patch replaced, padded part ignored
chain.constraint: outside valid patch exactly copied from normal; inside patch outside bbox NOT copied. No feather/alpha blending.

chain.input: slot class and original normalized bbox
chain.output: YOLO class 0/1 plus frozen bbox coordinates
chain.constraint: does not inspect generated pixels. Existing structural label audit checks metadata/bytes, not defect adherence.

questions.question: Are outside-bbox spatial latent cells updated?
questions.answer: YES. The complete latent grid is initialized/updated. Bbox conditioning does not prohibit outside-bbox latent changes.

questions.question: Are outside-bbox final pixels copied from the normal?
questions.answer: NOT inside the valid 512 patch. YES only outside the pasted patch. Bbox and patch must not be conflated.

questions.question: Is unmasked latent forcibly restored at each step?
questions.answer: NO in the active repository __call__, including actual 9-channel use. Do not infer upstream behavior.

questions.question: Is there extra compositing before final PNG?
questions.answer: YES full-patch paste, NO bbox-specific compositing. This hard-bounds full-canvas edits to the valid crop; it does not guarantee preservation outside the bbox.

questions.question: Is output annotation copied from input bbox?
questions.answer: YES; class and bbox are metadata-only label export.

questions.question: Can location accuracy be mechanically 100%?
questions.answer: Label-vs-input agreement would be tautologically 100%; it is forbidden as a pixel adherence endpoint. Actual residual centroid/extent/defect identity are not guaranteed.

spatial_domains.P: valid pasted crop intersection with Omega
spatial_domains.B: frozen rasterized bbox rectangle translated into full-canvas coordinates
spatial_domains.hard_support_statement: G=N on Omega minus P by code. This is not G=N on Omega minus B.
